protocol.method: Offline one-step contextual bandit, cached paired full-game engine rewards. REINFORCE samples an action and retrieves its recorded reward; action-independent mean-of-two counterfactual baseline reduces variance. No new engine games during optimization, no within-match RL.
protocol.selection: Validation mean reward only, including fixed-policy baselines. Fixed features/hyperparameters; no test tuning.
protocol.historicalCaveat: Game outcomes were collected in earlier bot experiments. These are model splits, not prospective new tournaments.

limitations: One action chooses an existing complete bot strategy; this is not fine-grained multi-agent RL.
Training episodes resample144 cached contexts, not150000 fresh games.
Primary double holdout is only32 games; no platform or policy-deployment claim.
